rv.q: "On Golden Pond" provides a rare and welcome opportunity to catch one in peak form.
The steady laughs come as a welcome surprise and soften the sentimental claptrap into far more palatable entertainment.

That the tranquility and stillness depicted in that painting extend to the cottage beyond the pond's shores - and, ultimately, the production containing it - is the most significant problem with this On Golden Pond.

cn.t: This revival of Thompson's play favors warm comedy over schmaltz, elevated by James Earl Jones's powerful performance, though critics remain divided on the production's overall impact.

vs.sum: A beautifully restored theater with a stunning Tiffany-inspired interior. The 2021 renovation transformed restroom facilities from among Broadway's worst to a model for the industry, with modern bathrooms on every public level.

acc.note: Elevator to Mezzanine, Balcony, and lower level restrooms. 7 wheelchair spaces across all levels.
